findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: save_processing_record, prepare_analysis, hermetics_status · Private data: save_processing_record, list_processing_records, pending_reviews, prepare_analysis, record_request · Public sink: report_breach.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: save_processing_record, prepare_analysis, hermetics_status · Private data: save_processing_record, list_processing_records, pending_reviews, prepare_analysis, record_request · Public sink: report_breach

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
